clips.title: The story
paras: Worgen roam Valgan's Field, a ruined farm overlooking Lordamere Lake in northern Silverpine Forest. Archmage Arugal unleashed the Moonrage pack, and the Forsaken now seek his abandoned research there.

Valgan's Field lies west of the Shining Strand and north of the nearby river, with Lordamere Lake beyond its ruined farmstead. The wheat farm once prospered, until the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and forced its owner, Valgan, to flee or die. Left untended, the buildings fell to feral Moonrage worgen prowling down from Shadowfang Keep. Before the Third War, Arugal spent time here and left remnants of his arcane research, which now draw the Forsaken's attention.
